terraform_version_support.notes: Last patch: 1.11.4. TFE workspace version until the Q4 2026 upgrade to 1.17 (docs/dependency-upgrade-plan-2026-q4.md, Phase 1).
Last patch: 1.12.2. Introduces ephemeral values and write-only attributes. Upgrade note: Linux kernel 3.2 or later required.
Last patch: 1.13.5. Upgrade note: external variables referenced in terraform test files should have a matching variable block in the test file.
Last patch: 1.14.9. Adds list resources, terraform query and actions. Upgrade note: reduced parallelism in container runtimes with a CPU bandwidth limit.
Last patch: 1.15.9. CI image until the Q4 2026 upgrade to 1.17 (hashicorp/terraform:1.15.2). Upgrade note: S3 backend AWS_USE_FIPS_ENDPOINT and AWS_USE_DUALSTACK_ENDPOINT accept only true or false.
Last patch: 1.16.7. Adds the terraform_data store block and import blocks inside modules. Upgrade note: provisioner bastion_host_key is now applied; no provisioners in this repo.

Used in TFC workspaces (tfe_workspace_tf_version = "1.17") and in CI (hashicorp/terraform:1.17.0). Required version constraint in repo: >= 1.5.7. Provider requirements accept variables and locals, -minimal-refresh planning option, Terraform Policy GA. No upgrade notes.
